title: The hotel wedding
summary: The team hotel has a wedding in the function room the night before a game. The bride wants a photo with you. The groom supports the other lot. The gaffer has a curfew. A season on, a christening photo arrives.

ends.title: In the album
ends.text: You're in a stranger's wedding album, in your club tracksuit, between the bride and a groom who supports the other lot. They sent you a copy.

ends.title: Curfew
ends.text: You kept the curfew and missed the wedding. You heard the conga line through the floor till two.

event.title: The bride
event.speaker: manager
setup: The team hotel, the night before an away game. There's a wedding in the function room. At half nine the bride, in the full dress, finds you by the lift. "Please. One photo. My dad's your biggest fan. My husband hates you."

say: {manager.name} is coming down the corridor in his slippers. "Curfew's ten. That includes weddings."

photo.text: Her dad cries. The groom shakes your hand very hard. You're in the lift at two minutes to ten. {manager.short} checks his watch and nods.

dance.text: One dance turns into a conga line. You're upstairs at quarter to eleven. {manager.short} is sitting on a chair outside your room.

bed.text: You go up. You can hear the conga line through the floor till two.

event.title: A parcel
event.speaker: manager
setup: A season on, a parcel at the training ground: a christening photo. A baby in your shirt. A card: "From the wedding at the hotel. He wanted the other shirt. I won."

outcomes.text: The lads ask. You tell them about the conga line. {manager.short}, passing, says, "Quarter to eleven," without stopping.
You put it up. You never met them. You were in bed by ten.
She sends back a photo of the wedding album, open at the page with you in it.
They send a thank-you. You never did go downstairs.
